notes.title: Update Details for Ver. 1.0.1.0 (6/14/2024)
notes.notes:
• Fixed a bug making it impossible for players to progress when certain cutscenes played.
• Fixed a bug preventing transparent bitmap images from loading properly.
  (Some transparent bitmap images will not load.)
• Fixed a bug in which text was displayed incorrectly in the English version of the game.
• Fixed a bug restricting selectable resolution settings.
• Added the option to skip cutscenes from the first playthrough.
• Fixed a bug in which soldier colors were incorrect.
• Fixed other minor bugs.
